name: Thoai Ngoc Hau Tomb
kicker: Tomb at the foot of Núi Sam
summary: Lăng Thoại Ngọc Hầu is the tomb at the foot of Núi Sam, visited with the shrine. The 2026 festival program brings his spirit tablet from this ground to Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ and returns it. The culture department stages him and his wife Châu Thị Tế as the people who opened land and dug the Vĩnh Tế canal. An architectural guide was not published. Hours and the fee are check on arrival.
getThere: Same cluster as Ba Chua Xu Temple, at the mountain.
heroCaption: The gate of Lăng Thoại Ngọc Hầu, with the mountain slope behind it
body: See the tomb of the mandarin whose story is tied to the shrine. The An Giang culture department’s 2026 opening staged Thoại Ngọc Hầu and Châu Thị Tế as the people who opened land and dug the Vĩnh Tế canal. During the festival the tablet procession uses this ground. On another morning it is a stop on the walk with the temple.

The photograph is the old gate, with the slope of Núi Sam behind it. The second frame is the tomb houses inside the complex. An architectural guide was not on the pages opened, so the visit is the gate and the ground, not a room-by-room tour.
Do not look for the tomb in the town market. TITC places it at the mountain, with the temple. Hours and a fee were not printed. Check on arrival.
